title: Quantum Physics & Cosmos Blitz
description: A high-octane physics quiz covering quarks, relativity, astrophysics, and black holes.

questions.question: What is the theoretical boundary around a black hole beyond which nothing can escape?
questions.explanation: The Event Horizon is the boundary where escape velocity equals or exceeds the speed of light.

questions.question: Which elementary particle is considered the carrier of the electromagnetic force?
questions.explanation: Photons are the gauge bosons responsible for mediating the electromagnetic interaction.

questions.question: What paradox illustrates the bizarre principle of quantum superposition using a feline?
questions.explanation: Erwin Schrödinger proposed the thought experiment in 1935 to highlight the strange nature of quantum superposition.
